editorial:
Schmidt and Jenko are two cops who look young enough to pass as high schoolers, and they get sent undercover to bust a dangerous drug ring. The funny part is that high school has totally changed since they were kids, so they have to deal with teenage drama all over again. It is a silly idea that actually works really well, and the movie never takes itself too seriously. You will laugh a lot, and the story moves fast enough to keep you hooked from start to finish.

The comedy is sharp, the action scenes are solid, and Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum have amazing chemistry as the buddy cop duo. Some jokes miss the mark, but most of them land, and the heart underneath the laughs feels real. If you enjoy buddy comedies with a mix of action and heart, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Schmidt and Jenko figure out that the drug dealer is actually the popular kid Eric, and the supplier is their own gym teacher. During a wild chase at prom, they finally bust the ring and clear their names. The big twist is that their captain reveals a new undercover mission at a college, setting up the sequel. You see them walk into a college campus, ready for more chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies with action and heart
